answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The network ties the river to sunk effort, uses the thread as an corroborating signal, then requires a lagoon before any payout.
